instructions: Answer each question about this support ticket from its text.

queue.description: Which team must act first on this support ticket?

options.technical: Bugs, crashes, outages, errors, performance, login problems
options.sales: Contracts, plan changes, pricing questions, cancellation threats, procurement
options.feedback: Praise, feature requests, general non-problem questions

urgency.description: How urgent is this support ticket?
levels: Can wait: praise, feature requests, idle questions, no problem
Normal: a real problem for one user without time pressure
Should be handled today: user is blocked, money wrongly taken, a deadline within days, or repeated contact
Drop everything: outage affecting many users, security incident, data loss, or enterprise customer about to churn

angry.description: The text itself shows anger (hostile wording, shouting, threats, sarcasm aimed at the company).

states: Does the annual receipt break out the sales tax separately? My accountant asked, and I haven't had one yet as I only joined in May. No hurry.
